app-title: Hub Formation bu Africa Pioneers - Extérieur
welcome-sub: Bunt bi ngir Dooleel Afrika ci Pi Ecosystem
africa-day: (Ci màggalug Bésub Afrika bu 25e, Application Formation bu Pi Pioneers bii lañu ubbi)
intro-p1: Pi Network mooy xaalis digital ak projet ecosystem global buñu defar ngir cryptocurrency manna am te am njariñ ci ñépp.
intro-p2: Wuute ak crypto yu cosaan yu laaj ay machine yu seer yu gëstu, Pi Network mooy may nit ñi ordinaire man a bokk direct ci seeni téléphone.
intro-list:
• Tabax ekonomi digital bu duggal ñépp
  • Dooleel nit ñi ordinaire ci àddina bépp
  • Yokku jëfandikoo bu dëgg
  • Jàppale jaay-dox bu nit ak nit
ch1-p2: Jaar 2: Bindu ci Facebook walla Téléphone → Duggal code: CHIGALEX1 → Am 1 Pi récompense
ch1-p3: Gëstu bu Bés bu ne: Dellu ci 24h yu ne te bësal bouton melax ngir yagga gëstu.
ch1-list:
• Sos portefeuille Pi ci kàddu
  • Matale 2FA
  • Matale KYC
  • Waajal ngir Mainnet
security-msg: ⚠️ Kàddu gu portefeuille: BUL SËP sa 24 baat yu passphrase! Ekip Pi Core DUSU la laaj!
ch2-p1: Portefeuille Pi yaw mooy banka yaw ci Pi Ecosystem. Mooy yor sa xaalis Pi ci kàddu ci blockchain.
ch2-p2: Naka lañu koy defare: Ubbi Pi Browser → Wallet → Sos Wallet → KOPIA sa 24 baat → Dencale offline ci 2 bérab bu woor.
ch2-p3: Am Pi: Séddoo sa adresse bu mbooloo (tàmbali ci G...). Yónni Pi: Coller adresse bu jotkat bi, duggal lim, confirmer.
ch2a-p1: Pratique: Tambali ci xaalis bu tuuti bu test (1 Pi). Vérifie 4 lettres yu jëkk ak 4 yu mujj yu adresse ñoo yem. Bul coller sa passphrase ci site benn!
ch3-p1: Pi Browser mooy melni Google Play Store ngir Pi. DApps ay application yu tasare ngir jëfandikoo bu dëgg — jaay, njàng, jeux, service yépp ci Pi.
ch4: CHAPITRE 4 — MAPOFPI & BOOLE BI JAAY KAT
ch4-p1: Gis jaay kat yi nangu Pi ci àddina bépp ci mapofpi.com. Bindu sa jaay kat sa bopp te tambali nangu Pi ngir jënd ak service.
ch5-p1: Valeur Consensus Mondial (GCV) dafay ñaan jëfandikoo bu dëgg. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Valeur bii lañu tabax ci pionniers yi jëfandikoo Pi ci jaay-dox bu dëgg.
ch6-p1: Jàngale manuel bu Doris Yin ngir sos jëfandikoo ak yokku gu ecosystem. Seet, jàng, jàngale yeneen — noonu lañuy dooleel Afrika.
final-msg: Afrika amna chance bu am doole ci jëfandikoo pratique ci Pi Ecosystem. Ñoo Bokke Tabax. Ñoo Bokke Jàngale.
